audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with Exodus/bowl judgment imagery; draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for seven bowls, unrepentance, Armageddon, Babylon remembered.

verses.restored: I heard great voice from temple saying to seven messengers: Go and pour out seven bowls of wrath of Divine into earth.

familiar.text: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.

verses.restored: The first went and poured his bowl upon earth; a harmful and painful sore came upon humans having mark of beast and worshiping its image.

familiar.text: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.

verses.restored: The second poured into sea; it became like blood/life of dead one, and every living soul/life in sea died.

familiar.text: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.

verses.restored: The third poured into rivers and springs of waters, and they became blood/life.

familiar.text: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.

verses.restored: I heard messenger of waters saying: Righteous/just are you, the One who is and who was, the Holy One, because you judged these things,

familiar.text: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.

verses.restored: because they poured out blood/life of holy ones and prophets, and blood/life you have given them to drink; they are worthy.

familiar.text: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.

verses.restored: And I heard altar saying: Yes, Lord Divine Almighty, true and righteous/just are your judgments.

familiar.text: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.

verses.restored: The fourth poured bowl upon sun, and it was given to scorch humans with fire.

familiar.text: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.

verses.restored: Humans were scorched with great heat and blasphemed name of Divine having authority over these plagues, and they did not turn to give him glory.

familiar.text: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.

verses.restored: The fifth poured bowl upon throne of beast, and its reign became darkened, and they gnawed their tongues from pain.

familiar.text: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,

verses.restored: They blasphemed Divine of heaven because of their pains and sores, and did not turn from their works.

familiar.text: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.

verses.restored: The sixth poured bowl upon great river Euphrates, and its water was dried, so way of kings from sunrise might be prepared.

familiar.text: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.

verses.restored: I saw from mouth of dragon, beast, and false prophet three unclean spirits like frogs.

familiar.text: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

verses.restored: For they are spirits of daimons doing signs, going out to kings of whole inhabited world to gather them into war of great day of Divine Almighty.

familiar.text: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.

verses.restored: Look, I come like thief. Blessed is the one keeping awake and keeping garments, so that one may not walk naked and they see one's shame.

familiar.text: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.

verses.restored: And they gathered them into place called in Hebrew Harmagedon.

familiar.text: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.

verses.restored: The seventh poured bowl upon air, and great voice came from temple from throne, saying: It has happened.

familiar.text: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.

verses.restored: Flashes, voices, thunders happened, and great shaking such as had not happened since human came upon earth.

familiar.text: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.

verses.restored: The great city became into three parts, cities of nations fell, and Babylon the great was remembered before Divine, to give her cup of wine of wrath of his anger.

familiar.text: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

verses.restored: Every island fled, and mountains were not found.

familiar.text: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

verses.restored: Great hail like talent-weight came down from heaven upon humans, and humans blasphemed Divine because of plague of hail, for its plague is very great.

familiar.text: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.

translation_notes: Bowls echo Exodus plagues and expose hardened refusal to turn.
Armageddon/Harmagedon is symbolic battle-gathering language; avoid modern war mapping.
Unclean frog-like spirits are propaganda/sign-working imagery from dragon/beast/false prophet mouths.
safety_note: Do not literalize bowls for fear prediction or military fantasies. The moral focus is hardened allegiance to beast/Babylon systems and refusal to turn.
